g.text: Five stacked protection layers that keep the model moving toward exploitation
• Soft nudge at 4 calls: "⚠️ Move to exploitation"
• Hard block at 9 calls: read/search tools return error
• Post-target monitor limits eg_run_script after target creation
• Post-payload monitor forces next payload send after 5 analysis calls
• Tracks calls since last progress (finding OR checklist OR exploit tool)
• Exploit mode: compile/run/send/debug count as progress
• Hard limit: terminate after 100 calls with NO finding
• Max 3 pivots; grounded progress mode ignores hallucinations
• Ring buffer of last 10 tool calls
• Single tool cannot use >50% of run budget
• On stall: session.abort() + inject pivot prompt
• Steers model off wedged engine: "kali engine is WEDGED"
• Tracks cumulative input tokens vs effective context window
• Calibration excludes initial system prompt tokens
